source_notes: Solution A/B use trehalose, glycerol and isoleucine in Normosol R. Visually inspected Figure 2 uses arbitrary-unit component levels; the original supplement has no absolute concentration map.
The comparator is 10% DMSO in Normosol R.
hiPSC-CMs were generated by Wnt pathway inhibition and sodium L-lactate purification; the CCND2 line came from a healthy female donor and was engineered to overexpress cyclin D2.

Optimization tested cooling rates 1, 3, and 5 °C/min and manual nucleation at −4, −6, and −8 °C. Three batches were used for nucleation-temperature optimization; Fig. 3 reports n=4 per condition and CPA for cooling-rate/nucleation comparisons.
Original supplement recomputation and endpoint-definition caveats are recorded in cm-2025-analysis.json; high recovery is not equivalent to preserved calcium signaling.
selection_rationale: Direct human iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte cryopreservation study with DMSO-free osmolyte formulation, thermal-parameter optimization, osmotic characterization, and post-thaw identity/function endpoints.
